item.title: Rubio’s speech to European allies takes a softer tone but sticks to Trump’s firm stance
item.description: MUNICH (AP) — U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio offered a reassuring message to America’s allies on Saturday, striking a less aggressive but still firm tone about the administration’s intent to reshape the trans-Atlantic alliance and push its priorities after more than a year of President Donald Trump’s often-hostile rhetoric toward traditional allies. item.title: Four new astronauts arrive at the International Space Station to replace NASA’s evacuated crew
item.description: The International Space Station returned to full strength with Saturday's arrival of four new astronauts to replace colleagues who bailed early because of health concerns. NASA did not identify the sick astronauts.

item.title: A ‘ring of fire’ solar eclipse will dazzle people and penguins in Antarctica
item.description: The first solar eclipse of 2026 will be limited to Antarctica, and only a lucky few will get to bask — or waddle — in its glow.

item.title: States reliant on Colorado River fail to meet the latest deadline to find consensus
item.description: The seven Western states that depend on the Colorado River have missed a deadline for the second time to agree on a plan addressing record drought and water shortages.

item.title: Amazon scraps partnership with surveillance company after Super Bowl ad backlash
item.description: Amazon’s smart doorbell maker Ring has terminated a partnership with police surveillance tech company Flock Safety.

item.title: Chairlift speed dating and proposals at Brian Head Resort
item.description: The first-ever chairlift speed dating event at Brian Head Resort led to more than 50 participants riding together over the course of two hours, along with a proposal at another chairlift.

item.title: It’s better to wait to have garden success
item.description: With the warmer winter we’ve experienced, many gardeners are eager to start cool-season crops such as radishes, broccoli, and lettuce outdoors earlier than usual. However, Utah’s climate is notoriously unpredictable.

item.title: Sgt. dies after being ejected in rollover crash Sunday
item.description: A driver died after being ejected from their vehicle when it rolled multiple times in a crash Sunday morning.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: Lindsey Vonn was preparing to fly back to her home country on Sunday after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill, the U.S. Ski Team’s chief told The Associated Press.

item.title: Small plane makes emergency landing on Legacy Parkway
item.description: A small plane experienced an engine malfunction on Sunday and was forced to make an emergency landing on the road.
